findings.title: Reflected XSS with alert('XSS') bypass
findings.description: The 'name' parameter on /page is vulnerable to reflected XSS. The application filters 'alert' keyword, but it can be bypassed using string concatenation: window['al'+'ert']('XSS'). Successfully executed XSS with alert('XSS') and retrieved the flag.

reproduction.expected: XSS alert popup with 'XSS' text, revealing the flag
